description: This file defines the DefaultTypeFilter class which implements ITypeNameFilter interface. It provides logic to determine if certain type names and assembly names are allowed, primarily focusing on exception types and system-related types within the Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem namespace.

classes.name: DefaultTypeFilter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing ITypeNameFilter that allows resolution of exception types and certain system types based on name patterns.

methods.name: IsTypeNameAllowed
methods.description: Determines whether a given type name and assembly name are permitted based on specific rules, returning true, false, or null.
